## Kody · Business Logic

**[#2104 · BYOK fallback not used when Z.AI returns its weekly usage-limit 429 (code 1310)](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/issues/2104)**
All requirements met · 20 to check manually
<sub>Task read 2026-10-29 21:19 UTC · at `0b28da5`</sub>

✅ 4 of 24 met: AC #9, AC #10, AC #12, AC #22

| | Requirement | In this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | Kody Rules failed with "all 8 rule check(s) failed to run" about a second after the run started. <sub>AC #1</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:133` · This is a reported historical failure, not a desired outcome; the diff tests the classifier rather than reproducing the original review run. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | The generalist agent failed about 31.5s after the run started, with Z.AI's 1310 error after 4 attempts. <sub>AC #2</sub> | This describes a historical failure; the diff does not reproduce the generalist agent's timing or retry sequence. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | The PR summary step failed (`Error generateOverallComment … Max retries exceeded`). <sub>AC #3</sub> | This describes an observed failure whose cause was unverified; the diff does not exercise the summary flow. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | The PR got the error reaction. <sub>AC #4</sub> | This is a historical observation; the diff does not exercise the PR reaction flow. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | On a self-hosted 2.2.3 instance, configure BYOK with a Z.AI GLM model as the primary and an OpenAI model as the fallback. <sub>AC #5</sub> | This is a reproduction setup; the diff does not show a self-hosted BYOK configuration. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | Use up the Z.AI plan's weekly limit. <sub>AC #6</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:134` · This is a reproduction step; the test simulates the error message rather than exhausting a live plan. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | Trigger a review on a PR that has Kody Rules. <sub>AC #7</sub> | This is a reproduction step; no end-to-end review is shown in the diff. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | 1113: `Insufficient balance or no resource package. Please recharge.` <sub>AC #8</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.ts:359` · This is a documented control error; the diff adds a separate 1310 phrase but does not show the full existing classifier for 1113. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | `libs/llm/error-classifier.ts:265-269 / 286-289`: a 429 is classified `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` only if `looksLikeQuota` matches the error text, otherwise `RATE_LIMIT`. <sub>AC #11</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.ts:365` · This describes the reported pre-fix mechanism; the diff changes looksLikeQuota but does not show the 429 classification branch. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | `libs/llm/model-failover.ts:74 / 99`: `shouldFailoverToNextModel` cascades a `RATE_LIMIT` only when `retriesWereExhausted(err)` is true, i.e. an `AI_RetryError` with `reason: 'maxRetriesExceeded'`. <sub>AC #13</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:141` · This describes the reported existing failover rule; the diff calls shouldFailoverToNextModel but does not show its implementation. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | `libs/llm/structured-review-call.ts:353 / 509`: one-shot calls set `maxRetries: 0`, so they throw a bare `AI_APICallError` and never an `AI_RetryError`. For these calls a 1310/1308 response never fails over. Kody Rules makes its checks through this path (`kody-rules-agent.provider.ts:280 / 284`). That fits the logs: Kody Rules failed about 1.2s into each run. <sub>AC #14</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:133` · The test checks failover for a bare 1310 error, correcting the reported classification issue, but the Kody Rules call path and its retry settings are not shown in the diff. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | `libs/llm/agent-loop-call.ts:57`: agent-loop calls set `AGENT_STEP_MAX_RETRIES = 3`, which accounts for "Failed after 4 attempts" and the ~31.5s. An exhausted retry qualifies the error for failover. However, `libs/llm/llm.ts` (`loopWithFailoverGuard`) marks an attempt unsafe to retry once any step has finished, and after that the error is re-thrown instead of cascading. <sub>AC #15</sub> | This describes a possible existing agent-loop mechanism; the diff does not show the loop or its retry guard, and the task says the cause was not confirmed. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | `libs/llm/model-failover.ts:236` and `:261` (2.2.3) log the failover decision (`[LLM-ERROR] … failed (<category>)` / `[LLM-ERROR] [model-failover] …`) at WARN. With `API_LOG_LEVEL=error` those lines are not written, which is why they are missing from the evidence above. <sub>AC #16</sub> | This describes historical logging behavior; the relevant logging code is not shown in the diff. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | **The category Kodus actually assigned at runtime.** The decision is logged at WARN, and this instance logs at ERROR only. `RATE_LIMIT` comes from running the 2.2.3 classifier code on the logged error, not from a runtime log line. <sub>AC #17</sub> | The historical runtime category is explicitly unverified and cannot be established from this diff. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | **Why the generalist agent didn't fail over.** At both 2.2.3 and main, an exhausted 429 would cascade unless a loop step had already finished. We did not confirm whether a step had finished. ~31.5s for 4 attempts fits a single call retried with backoff, but does not prove it. <sub>AC #18</sub> | The cause of the historical generalist failure remains unverified; the diff does not show the agent-loop execution. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | **The summary failure's cause.** `generateOverallComment … Max retries exceeded` was observed. Its underlying error and code path were not checked. <sub>AC #19</sub> | The task identifies this cause as unverified; the diff does not investigate the summary path. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | **The UI's start time.** The Kodus UI showed "Started: 2026-10-09 07:58" with no timezone. That doesn't obviously match either logged run, and the log output was cut at 40 lines, so there may be a third run we did not see. <sub>AC #20</sub> | This is an unverified historical observation; the diff does not address or reproduce the displayed start time. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | **Whether the OpenAI fallback would have succeeded** if it had been called. We did not test this. <sub>AC #21</sub> | The diff does not show a live OpenAI fallback attempt, so its success for the historical runs cannot be established. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | When the primary returns an error that won't clear for a day or more, calls go to the configured fallback and the review completes on it. <sub>Description: Expected result</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.ts:365`, `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:133` · The 1310 error is recognized as quota exhaustion and the test verifies the failover decision; completion of a review using the configured fallback requires an end-to-end check. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | Confirm it still holds in the current code before changing anything, and correct this issue if it does not. Do not ship a fix for a cause this report did not prove. <sub>Description</sub> | `libs/llm/error-classifier.spec.ts:133` · The diff adds a regression test for the reported 1310 classifier and failover decision, but the prior investigation and any correction to the issue cannot be established from the diff. |

<sub>Disagree with a line? Reply here and mention @kody. Fixed it? Comment `@kody -v business-logic` and this comment is updated.</sub>
